name: Combat pose - industrial foundry
description: Generates cinematic action-editorial portraits set inside an industrial foundry, combining armed combat poses, molten-metal atmosphere, smoke, sparks, and high-intensity dystopian character styling.
author: SV75

Her poised gaze and minimalist white tank top evoke both serene strength and avant-garde innovation.
